description: A utility class within the OFBiz framework that manages external JavaScript linking for HTML templates. It converts inline scripts to external links, caches scripts per user session, and facilitates the insertion of script tags at the end of HTML pages for Content Security Policy compliance.

classes.name: ScriptLinkHelper
classes.description: A final utility class offering static methods to manage script link insertion, caching, and cleanup to support content security policies.

methods.name: addScriptLinkForBodyEnd
methods.description: Adds a script URL to the set of scripts to be included at the end of the HTML body.

methods.name: getScriptLinksForBodyEnd
methods.description: Retrieves the set of script URLs scheduled to be placed at the end of the HTML body.

methods.name: putScriptInCache
methods.description: Stores a script's content in a cache associated with a user session, returning a key for retrieval.

methods.name: getScriptFromCache
methods.description: Retrieves and removes a script's content from the cache based on session and filename.

methods.name: cleanupScriptCache
methods.description: Removes all scripts associated with a session when it is invalidated.

methods.name: prepareScriptLinkForBodyEnd
methods.description: Creates a cache entry for a script, builds a URL reference with CSRF token, stores it for footer inclusion, and returns a status.
